changelog: Places the series toggle the way Jellyfin Enhanced places its own detail buttons, and ahead of them. Its Spoiler Guard button re-claims the slot directly before the More button on every tick, so anything else insisting on that same slot traded places with it several times a second - the toggle now anchors ahead of Jellyfin Enhanced's buttons instead, which leaves that invariant alone and settles both. Works out the same for any combination of Jellyfin Enhanced's options, including none of them, and the toggle still sits inside the button group rather than past the More button.
description: Clears the first episodes of never-started series out of Next Up and collapses duplicate episodes of one series in Continue Watching, so both rows only hold shows you are actually watching. Filtering changes no watch data; an opt-in scheduled task can also clear the play state of barely-started episodes.
name: Next Up Cleanup
overview: Next Up without the first episode of every show you never started, and Continue Watching without the same show four times.
